title: Rays complete sweep of Yankees to advance to ALCS - ESPN
description: Victor Mesa Jr. hit the home run that effectively ended the Yankees' season Wednesday night as the Rays won 4-3 to complete a sweep that affirmed Tampa Bay's summer-long dominance of their division rival.

title: Kourtney Kardashian Reacts to Jennifer Lawrence Calling Her "More Annoying Than Ever" - E! News
description: After Jennifer Lawrence called Kourtney Kardashian "annoying" while taking Vanity Fair's lie detector test, she playfully reacted to the shade during the season eight premiere of The Kardashians.
